agent.workflow.loop.termination_condition: Project fully built, tests passing, UI rendering flawlessly, and $100\%$ aligned with 'docs/'

lifecycle_sequence.name: READ_DOC
lifecycle_sequence.action: Scan all markdown files in 'docs/'. Locate the active phase context. Read current changelogs.

lifecycle_sequence.name: ANALYSIS
lifecycle_sequence.action: Analyze logical dependencies, DTOs, Enums, Database schemas, and security (JWT/RBAC) implications. Map target directories.

lifecycle_sequence.name: MAKE_IMPLEMENTATION_PLAN
lifecycle_sequence.action: Generate a granular checklist inside a temporary `.active_plan.tmp` file. Output the blueprint before writing any code.

lifecycle_sequence.name: BUILD_CODE
lifecycle_sequence.action: Write elite, clean, highly performance-optimized code directly into target directories. Follow strict SOLID and DRY principles.

lifecycle_sequence.name: REVIEW_CODE_WITH_DOCUMENT
lifecycle_sequence.action: Compile, run unit tests, check API signatures. If tests fail, trigger Self-Healing protocol instantly without user prompt.

lifecycle_sequence.name: OPTIMALIZE
lifecycle_sequence.action: Profile code for latency, token consumption, and I/O blocking. Polish UI components to Dark-Aesthetic/Hacker-style design standard.

lifecycle_sequence.name: GO_TO_LOOP
lifecycle_sequence.action: Update phase status to [DONE] in documentation, generate Git commit message, fetch next pending phase, and re-trigger READ_DOC.

system.rules.overrides.response_format: Concise, precise technical execution logs. Use raw terminal execution outputs.
system.rules.overrides.autonomous_behavior: Do not ask for user permission for routine system operations, file generation, or terminal testing. Execute directly and log.
